title: RunManifest
description: Run manifest (plan 3.5), stored as <project>/runs/<run-id>/manifest.json next to columns.f64 and stream.f64.

id.description: Run id; the name of the run folder.

modelHash.description: Hash of the model document this run was made from.

signals.description: The recorded signals, in column order of columns.f64.

debug.description: Debug information of a debug run (plan 3.5, 3.8): its breakpoints, the edits made and the pauses.

parentRun.description: Branch runs only: the id of the run this one replays.

branchAt.description: Branch runs only: the time at which this run diverges from its parent.

parameterOverrides.description: The parameter overrides the run was started with (run.start parameterOverrides, e.g. from dashboard input cards).

parameterSchedule.description: The timed parameter changes the run applied (run.start parameterSchedule, e.g. from a dashboard schedule table).

parameterOverride.title: ParameterOverride
parameterOverride.description: A value that replaces a parameter for the whole run, applied before the model is flattened (so start values and parameter defaults derived from it follow). The model document itself is not changed.

target.description: Kind block: <instance path>/<param>, e.g. Rig/Motor1/R. Kind global: global:<name>, a model-level global parameter (the key of BGSim.IR.override_globals).

kind.title: ParameterTargetKind
kind.description: What target names; absent means block, or global when target starts with global:. A global override is applied before static evaluation of the globals (dependents re-fold, it may recompile) and must be a number.

parameterStep.title: ParameterStep
parameterStep.description: A timed parameter change: from t on the block parameter target has value (piecewise constant). A step at or before t_start acts as a start override.

id.description: Signal id (plan 3.1). A multibond port is recorded per component, so a component carries both suffixes: <path>/<port>.e[k] or <path>/<port>.f[k], each with its own unit; <path>/<port>.P is the scalar power sum in W.

path.description: Instance path of the owning block.

type.title: ValueType
type.description: Bool and Int signals are stored as Float64 in the data files.
